After twenty loops nothing here predicts a number, only a class. AUC cannot fail the way
R-squared can: the mean scores exactly zero and a bad model scores negative.

A QUANTITY IS PREDICTED. First held-out R-squared in this project, and the first time the
loop's distinctive content -- turnover and dilution -- has added anything to anything.
BUT READ Y2 CAREFULLY: the slope is 1.2977 against a ceiling of 1.3, which is 0.0023 from failing. A slope of 1.30 means a
tenfold change in transcript goes with a 20-fold change in protein.
That is AMPLIFICATION, not proportionality. The gate passed because the band was
wide, not because the equation's form was vindicated, and calling this
'proportional' would be the overstatement this project exists to avoid.
